title: Bound fixed-partner two-ADD retiming across three public MOVEs
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**NO VERIFIED GAIN.** The comparator is independently reproduced #7334 at `aaeec8c0acf01e99a5f331ef363a698d9c084ace` with signed #7113 at `07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d`.

This exhausts the five three-MOVE public windows in the frozen #7365 changed-role census with exactly two incident ADDs. The proposed contraction retains both original operands, their signed coefficients and order, and every other paid path. The lead tests 47,490 typed cuts over 15 direct-MOVE placements and finds zero legal ADD slots. The independent barrier walk grants any direct-MOVE clock in the original window. None of the ten partners reaches either required chart in its permitted interval. The owned donor 1555 stays in its original lifetime. All five windows are excluded within this scope.

One direct replacement would remove 34 paid positions across the signed 17 copies and leave 22,461 productive positions. At most three replacements fit after overlapping paid clocks are counted once. The optimistic compatible credit is bounded above by 1.548051774782075 raw, granting ancillary costs free. Verified saving is zero.

## Task and overlap

This changes the #7365 contact-census scope to a three-MOVE contraction with two original ADDs. #7368 checks a related sole-ADD case. #7369 covers the overlapping chart-746 roles with six paid legs and fixed ADD clocks. #7371 and #7372 cover distinct two-MOVE scopes. Canonical main was `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57` at the pre-submit refresh.

## Validation

Use CPython 3.12 with assertions enabled from a clean checkout.

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/p104-three-move-two-add-retime-bound/replay.py
```

The Git-free replay authenticates the predecessor census and price, regenerates four matching receipts, and checks both exact audits. Synthetic ADD commutation and COPY/ownership barriers passed. In a separate relocated control, changing the census caused rejection before the audit. The research commit adds one package and uses the two existing #7257 CI fixes for the historical selected replay gap documented in #7371. The selected record is unchanged.

## Credit

#7365 supplies the contact census. #7362 supplies the paid and productive rank stock. #7338 supplies overlapping two-MOVE keys and the signed admission, #7298 the directed arithmetic, and #7003 the earlier commuting slide. OpenAI Codex and subagents materially assisted.

## Open next questions

Test whether different endpoint donors can supply the two incoming ADDs as one exact aggregate on the first role-532 window. The fixed-partner exclusion leaves that distinct changed-donor route open. Review and merge are left to the maintainers.
